बॉक्स ऑफिस पर आ गया है ऐसा भूचाल जिसे देखकर सब हैरान हैं! 🔥
नितेश तिवारी के निर्देशन में बनी फिल्म Ramayana ने दुनियाभर में तहलका मचा दिया है और सिर्फ 5 दिनों में वर्ल्डवाइड ग्रॉस कलेक्शन 671.55 करोड़ रुपये पर पहुंच गया है।
9 नवंबर, सोमवार यानी रिलीज के पांचवें दिन इस फिल्म के साथ कन्नड़ सिनेमा के स्टार Yash ने एक ऐतिहासिक रिकॉर्ड अपने नाम कर लिया है।
report के मुताबिक Ramayana के 671.55 करोड़ और उनकी साल 2026 की एक्शन थ्रिलर फिल्म Toxic के 333.49 करोड़ रुपये को मिलाकर इस साल Yash का कुल ग्लोबल बॉक्स ऑफिस कलेक्शन 1005.04 करोड़ रुपये हो गया है।
इस बड़ी उपलब्धि के साथ Yash पोस्ट-COVID दौर में अकेले ऐसे भारतीय एक्टर बन गए हैं जिन्होंने एक ही साल में दूसरी बार 1000 करोड़ का ग्लोबल आंकड़ा पार किया है। 🎬
इससे पहले Yash ने साल 2022 में KGF: Chapter 2 के जरिए अकेले 1228.59 करोड़ रुपये कमाए थे।
क्या आपने सिनेमाघरों में जाकर यह फिल्म देख ली है? 🍿

ctx.title: Ramayana Worldwide Box Office: Yash Becomes The Only Indian Actor To Hit 1000 Crore In A Single Year For The 2nd Time Post-COVID!
ctx.summary:
Yash hits 1000 crore milestone in a single year record for the second time with Ramayana worldwide box office inching towards 700 crore club! 
 The post  Ramayana Worldwide Box Office: Yash Becomes The Only Indian Actor To Hit 1000 Crore In A Single Year For The 2nd Time Post-COVID!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
The global box office record books have just witnessed an absolute historical rewriting! Director Nitesh Tiwari’s mythological visual spectacle Ramayana continues its unstoppable rampage across worldwide circuits. The film is inching towards a gross collection of 700 crore globally. In 5 days, it stands at a gross collection of 671.55 crore at the box office worldwide!
Cruising through its First Monday, Day 5, November 9, the mythological epic has brought a personal milestone for Yash! With this 5-day global tsunami, Kannada cinema’s Rocking Star has unlocked a commercial achievement that stands almost entirely unmatched in Indian cinema history!
By combining Ramayana’s 5-day worldwide total of 671.55 crore with his earlier 2026 action thriller Toxic’s lifetime worldwide gross of 333.49 crore , Yash’s cumulative global box office haul for the year 2026 officially stands at 1005.04 crore!
This makes Yash the only Indian actor, post-COVID to hit the 1000 crore global milestone in a single year, for the second time! Meanwhile, apart from him, Prabhas is the only actor to hit the 1000 crore single-year worldwide box office milestone twice in his career – Once in 2017, and then in 2023! Yash first shattered global box office norms in 2022, when his pan-India blockbuster KGF: Chapter 2 amassed an incredible 1228.59 crore gross worldwide, crossing the single-year 4-digit threshold on the back of a single release.
In 2026, he has repeated history by pairing Geetu Mohandas’s gritty saga Toxic with Nitesh Tiwari ‘s grand spectacle Ramayana in just 5 days, taking his annual cumulative total to 1,005.04 crore , with Ramayana still in the initial days of its theatrical run!
Inching toward the 700 crore global gross milestone in just 5 days, Ramayana has cemented its position as a global box office hurricane! With Yash unlocking his second 1,000 crore single-year milestone and post-Diwali weekday pre-sales breaking national benchmarks, Nitesh Tiwari’s epic is set to rapidly storm past the ₹800 crore mark before its opening week comes to a close!
